reason: My cousin back home already handles this for me and it costs me nothing but a favour. I'd need to see this actually save me a trip before I pay a stranger's company.
objection: My Indian bank will still call me or ask me to come in, so I don't believe the 'no branch visit' part until it has worked for someone I know.
would_change_my_mind: A friend in my circle who moved ₹10 lakh this way without his bank asking for anything extra, or my own bank in India confirming in writing that it accepts this process.
